title: Green Lantern #178 DC 1984 1st Predator Cameo Demolition Team Dave Gibbons Wein
condition_description: Bright cover with light handling wear; back cover lightly toned. See photos.
description:
Green Lantern #178 (July 1984), DC Comics. First appearance of the Predator (cameo, last page); the Demolition Team attacks Ferris Aircraft. Written by Len Wein, art and cover by Dave Gibbons. 75 cent cover price.

Back cover: SportsNow magazine ad (The Ripkens of Baltimore).

Condition: bright cover with light handling wear; back cover lightly toned (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
